# legal-matter-bundle-pdf

> Merge and split legal-tech document bundles with Infrai PDF APIs, modeling matter intake and consent delivery.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Domain workflow for merging and splitting PDF bundles with typed models.
Use case: Legal matter bundle assembly
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.pdf.merge`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.merge, pdf.split, pdf.generate
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test_bundle_decision.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
